title: Session: no phone number, no metadata trail

intro.headline: Chat without tying it to your phone number.
intro.subhead: Session is a decentralized, E2E-encrypted messenger that hides your IP address and never asks for a phone number or email.

outro.headline: Your identity stays yours.
outro.subhead: Session gives you private messaging with minimal metadata exposure — perfect when you want to keep your identity and location private.
